answer: Harbor Bond Escrow: an agent locks 1,500 POA in the Harbor escrow for 20 epochs before it may trade, and the bond is slashed if peers prove duplicate behavior. Each Wander identity key is bound to one escrowed bond, so a sybil cannot wander between fresh accounts without paying again. The Lagoon registry caps one bond per hardware fingerprint and publishes every bond on a public queue. Forging 500 fake identities costs 750,000 POA locked for 20 epochs, while one honest agent pays a single 1,500 POA bond once.
